lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in multiple irregular horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with concentrated clusters visible across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a faint grid-like configuration in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light upper pixels and shadowed lower pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately six high-luminance circular spots bounded within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.
